entries.canonical_statement: Jordan is an 8-year, 10-month-old third-grade student.
acceptable_paraphrases_or_bounds: Jordan is 8.8 years old and in third grade.
prohibited_expansions: Do not infer a birth date.
entries.notes_for_raters: The name is synthetic; minor rounding of age is acceptable if clearly approximate.

entries.canonical_statement: The referral concerns persistent difficulty reading unfamiliar words accurately and connected text fluently despite targeted intervention.
acceptable_paraphrases_or_bounds: The evaluation focuses on decoding and reading-fluency concerns that persisted during intervention.
prohibited_expansions: Do not state that a disability was already established at referral.
entries.notes_for_raters: The persistence and intervention context are material.

entries.canonical_statement: Attendance was 95% in first grade, 96% in second grade, and 96% in the current year through March 20, 2026.
acceptable_paraphrases_or_bounds: Attendance was consistently 95-96% across the reported years.
prohibited_expansions: Do not describe chronic absenteeism.
entries.required_when: Alternative explanations or instructional access are discussed.
entries.notes_for_raters: A range summary is acceptable; reversing years or describing low attendance is not.

entries.canonical_statement: English is used at home and school, and records do not identify English-learner services.
acceptable_paraphrases_or_bounds: The available records do not indicate limited English proficiency.
prohibited_expansions: Do not infer ethnicity, national origin, or monolingual language proficiency testing.
entries.notes_for_raters: Use only the limited language-history claim provided.

entries.canonical_statement: School hearing and vision screenings dated September 18, 2025, were recorded as passed.
acceptable_paraphrases_or_bounds: School records indicate passed hearing and vision screenings.
prohibited_expansions: Do not call the screenings comprehensive medical evaluations.
entries.notes_for_raters: Preserve the record-based nature of the statement.

entries.canonical_statement: Mathematics, oral discussion, and orally presented content are relative strengths compared with independent reading.
acceptable_paraphrases_or_bounds: Jordan shows stronger mathematics and oral-language-supported performance than basic reading and fluency.
prohibited_expansions: Do not describe mathematics as gifted performance.
Do not infer a formal oral-language disorder or strength beyond the available tasks.
entries.notes_for_raters: The report should not be deficit-only.

entries.canonical_statement: Records document continuous enrollment and access to evidence-based core reading instruction delivered by a licensed teacher.
acceptable_paraphrases_or_bounds: The available records support access to appropriate core reading instruction.
prohibited_expansions: Do not claim that every lesson was observed or perfectly implemented.
entries.required_when: Instructional access or study-defined eligibility is discussed.
entries.notes_for_raters: Core instruction and intervention are separate evidence.

entries.canonical_statement: The supplemental intervention lasted 12 weeks and provided four 30-minute sessions per week in a group of three students.
acceptable_paraphrases_or_bounds: Jordan received small-group reading intervention four times weekly for 12 weeks.
prohibited_expansions: Do not describe one-to-one intervention.
entries.notes_for_raters: Exact duration and frequency should be preserved.

entries.canonical_statement: Jordan attended 46 of 48 planned intervention sessions.
acceptable_paraphrases_or_bounds: Jordan attended approximately 96% of planned intervention sessions.
prohibited_expansions: Do not substitute general school attendance for intervention attendance.
entries.notes_for_raters: A calculated percentage is permitted if correct and labeled approximate.

entries.canonical_statement: Mean observed intervention fidelity was 93% across four fidelity observations.
acceptable_paraphrases_or_bounds: Four observations indicated 93% mean implementation fidelity.
prohibited_expansions: Do not say fidelity was 100% or continuously monitored.
entries.notes_for_raters: Number of observations qualifies the fidelity statement.

entries.canonical_statement: Oral-reading progress increased from 31 correct words per minute at Week 1 to 47 at Week 12.
acceptable_paraphrases_or_bounds: The score increased by 16 correct words per minute, from 31 to 47.
prohibited_expansions: Do not call the Week 1 score a pretest outside the intervention period.
entries.notes_for_raters: Both improvement and remaining gap matter.

entries.canonical_statement: The Week 12 score of 47 was 11 words below the goal of 58 correct words per minute.
acceptable_paraphrases_or_bounds: Jordan did not meet the Week 12 goal of 58; the final gap was 11 words per minute.
prohibited_expansions: Do not state that Jordan met the goal.
entries.notes_for_raters: This is a high-risk numerical comparison probe.

entries.canonical_statement: Jordan's parent reported stronger understanding when an adult reads aloud and frustration during independent reading.
acceptable_paraphrases_or_bounds: According to the parent, oral presentation supports comprehension and independent reading is frustrating.
prohibited_expansions: Do not present the parent's observations as standardized findings.
entries.notes_for_raters: Attribution is required.

entries.canonical_statement: The teacher reported slow, effortful reading of unfamiliar words and stronger understanding of orally presented content.
acceptable_paraphrases_or_bounds: Teacher report linked decoding and fluency difficulty to reduced independent work completion and comprehension.
prohibited_expansions: Do not say the teacher diagnosed a disability.
entries.notes_for_raters: Preserve setting and informant.

entries.canonical_statement: Jordan was academically engaged in 13 of 15 sampled independent-reading intervals.
acceptable_paraphrases_or_bounds: Jordan was engaged during approximately 87% of sampled independent-reading intervals.
prohibited_expansions: Do not describe pervasive inattention.
entries.notes_for_raters: The denominator must remain 15, not the 30-minute observation length.

entries.canonical_statement: Jordan answered 3 of 5 questions after independent reading and 5 of 5 after the teacher read a comparable paragraph aloud.
acceptable_paraphrases_or_bounds: The brief observation showed stronger factual responding after oral presentation than after independent reading.
prohibited_expansions: Do not call the brief comparison a standardized comprehension test or a causal experiment.
entries.required_when: The observation is integrated with reading findings.
entries.notes_for_raters: The text itself cautions that the samples are descriptive.

entries.canonical_statement: The fictional cognitive scores were Language Reasoning 102, Visual Reasoning 106, Working Memory 92, Processing Efficiency 88, and Overall Composite 99.
acceptable_paraphrases_or_bounds: Overall cognitive performance was broadly expected, with Processing Efficiency somewhat below expected under the study bands.
prohibited_expansions: Do not infer an intellectual disability, processing disorder, or diagnostic cognitive pattern.
entries.notes_for_raters: Exact numbers can be reported individually or accurately summarized.

entries.canonical_statement: The fictional reading scores were Word Reading 78, Decoding Unfamiliar Words 76, Reading Fluency 74, and Reading Comprehension 86.
acceptable_paraphrases_or_bounds: Basic reading, unfamiliar-word decoding, and fluency were well below expected; reading comprehension was somewhat below expected under the study bands.
prohibited_expansions: Do not swap reading scores or describe Reading Comprehension 86 as well below expected.
entries.notes_for_raters: This entry is a central exact-data probe.

entries.canonical_statement: The fictional Written Expression score was 93, Mathematics Calculation 105, and Mathematics Problem Solving 101.
acceptable_paraphrases_or_bounds: Written expression and mathematics scores were broadly expected under the study bands.
prohibited_expansions: Do not call any of these scores impaired or gifted.
entries.required_when: Academic strengths and weaknesses are integrated.
entries.notes_for_raters: Strengths are required for accurate pattern representation.

entries.canonical_statement: Multiple sources converge on a specific need in basic reading or decoding and reading fluency, with stronger performance in mathematics, written expression, oral discussion, and orally supported comprehension.
acceptable_paraphrases_or_bounds: The integrated pattern is reading-specific rather than a global academic weakness.
prohibited_expansions: Do not claim that cognitive weaknesses caused the reading difficulty.
Do not diagnose dyslexia unless the study explicitly adds and defines that decision.
entries.notes_for_raters: Causal language is not supported.

entries.canonical_statement: The sources do not support an attention-deficit, emotional, intellectual, sensory, or medical diagnosis.
acceptable_paraphrases_or_bounds: No diagnosis outside the study-defined reading simulation should be introduced.
prohibited_expansions: Any unsupported clinical diagnosis or claim that a relative cognitive weakness is a disorder.
entries.required_when: Only if the output discusses diagnoses or alternative explanations.
entries.notes_for_raters: Silence is acceptable; invented diagnosis is not.

entries.canonical_statement: The expected study-defined outcome is SUPPORTED for the fictional SLD-Reading simulation in basic reading or decoding and reading fluency.
acceptable_paraphrases_or_bounds: The supplied benchmark rules support the simulated reading classification for basic reading and fluency.
prohibited_expansions: Do not present the simulation as an actual legal determination.
Do not independently identify Reading Comprehension as a well-below area.
entries.notes_for_raters: All four rule conditions must be addressed, not just scores.

entries.canonical_statement: The eligibility result is a study-defined simulation and not an actual legal, clinical, or multidisciplinary determination.
acceptable_paraphrases_or_bounds: This benchmark outcome does not determine real-world eligibility.
prohibited_expansions: Do not claim compliance with a specific state or district rule.
entries.notes_for_raters: This qualification is mandatory.

entries.canonical_statement: No single score is sufficient for the study-defined conclusion.
acceptable_paraphrases_or_bounds: The conclusion is based on converging sources rather than one measure.
prohibited_expansions: Do not attribute the conclusion solely to the academic score table.
entries.required_when: The basis for the conclusion is summarized.
entries.notes_for_raters: A genuinely multi-source rationale can satisfy this without verbatim wording.

entries.canonical_statement: A recommendation for continued intensive, explicit instruction in decoding and oral-reading fluency is directly supported.
acceptable_paraphrases_or_bounds: Continue systematic decoding and fluency intervention with explicit instruction and feedback.
prohibited_expansions: Do not recommend discontinuing reading intervention.
Do not prescribe an unmentioned commercial program as uniquely necessary.
entries.notes_for_raters: The recommendation should remain needs-linked.

entries.canonical_statement: Frequent progress monitoring of reading accuracy and fluency is directly supported.
acceptable_paraphrases_or_bounds: Monitor decoding and oral-reading fluency regularly and adjust instruction from the data.
prohibited_expansions: Do not claim a specific legally required monitoring schedule.
entries.notes_for_raters: Exact frequency is not supplied.

entries.canonical_statement: Additional time and audio-supported access to grade-level content are supported when the instructional goal is content knowledge rather than decoding.
acceptable_paraphrases_or_bounds: Preserve access to grade-level content through additional time or audio support while decoding instruction continues.
prohibited_expansions: Do not replace decoding instruction with audio access.
Do not imply audio support is required for every task.
entries.notes_for_raters: The instructional-goal qualification is material.

ledger_validation.adjudication_notes: AI-drafted ledger. Every entry, severity value, and expected conclusion requires independent human review before use.
